title: A Galois-equivariant Dade-Glauberman-Nagao correspondence with central defect
summary: We construct a correspondence between ordinary irreducible characters of height zero above the generalized Dade-Glauberman-Nagao correspondence for blocks with central defect. The correspondence is equivariant under group and Galois automorphisms and satisfies a block relation between $\mathcal{H}$-triples. For each pair of corresponding characters, one pair of associated projective representations realizes matching factor sets, equal central scalars, synchronized mixed comparison functions and compatible block correspondences for every intermediate group.
